analytics.name: Analytic 1850
analytics.guidance: For Android, detect Hooking from documented management, network, or vetting evidence; treat state queries as periodic observations rather than real-time events. Correlate Application Permission via Android Enterprise DPC / Application Vetting [DevicePolicyManager.getPermissionGrantState(); PackageManager manifest/requested-permission review]; OS API Execution via Application Vetting / Instrumented Dynamic Analysis [Dynamic API/runtime trace: App process loads external code module or native library from non-system path injected into zygote or app_process runtime — abnormal library injection path is the hooking mechanism indicator]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

tuning.description: Default 3600s — hooking framework deployment may lag root acquisition. Root detection is the gate; hooking evidence narrows within the window.
